question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym for the given word.**

Compel
solution:
The correct answer is: **Obligate**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Compel **means to force or drive someone to do something; to make someone feel obligated to do something. (**दबाव डालना**)

 
 
• **Example**: *The evidence was so compelling that the jury had no choice but to convict the defendant.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Obligate **means to bind or constrain by a legal, moral, or social obligation; to require or compel someone to do something. (**बाध्य**)
 
 
• **Example**: *Signing the contract will obligate you to fulfil the terms and conditions specified within it.*
 
 
 
• Hence, it is clear that the most appropriate synonym for 'compel' is 'obligate'.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Allow**: To permit or give permission; to enable someone to do something. (**अनुमति देना**)
 
• **Stop**: To cease or halt an action or movement; to prevent something from continuing. (**रुकना**)
 
• **Give**: To transfer the possession or ownership of something to someone else. (**देना**)
